sentences.en: Hastily acquired knowledge was not enough to solve the problem.

sentences.en: To my knowledge, this chemical will prevent germs from breeding.

sentences.en: To the best of my knowledge, he will not come.

senses.zh: 知识，学问；了解，认识；学识，见闻
